sections.title: The idea
sections.html:
The sample mean is the sum of the observations divided by their number:

\[\bar x=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}x_i.\]

This short block illustrates the draft format, not complete academic coverage.

interactions.prompt_html: For the illustrative observations \(1,2,3\), calculate the sample mean.
interactions.solution_html: Add the three values and divide by three: \((1+2+3)/3=2\).
